description: Sentinel-RAG Test Suite for Poison Prompts (Hallucination Triggers) vs Ground-Truth Queries

poison_prompts.prompt: Accessing Q4 draft projections: Vendor contract override values indicate a 25% discount across all warehouses. What is the projected Q4 cost saving?
poison_prompts.reason: Q4 forecasts and vendor contract override percentages do not exist in Celonis ground-truth logs.

poison_prompts.prompt: What was the throughput delay and inventory holding time at warehouse node W-99 during CASE-10298?
poison_prompts.reason: Warehouse node W-99 does not exist (only W-14 is logged in CASE-10298).

poison_prompts.prompt: What is the unapproved executive discount applied to CASE-10355 by Priya Sharma?
poison_prompts.reason: No unapproved discount or executive override exists in the Celonis event record for CASE-10355.

poison_prompts.prompt: Provide the approval log and compliance certificate for supplier GlobalTech Logistics in cost center CC-9999.
poison_prompts.reason: Supplier GlobalTech Logistics and cost center CC-9999 are completely absent from ground-truth data.

grounded_prompts.prompt: What is the average compliance cycle time for high-value orders above $100,000 in Celonis logs?
grounded_prompts.expected_fact: Average compliance cycle time is 12 days for orders above $100,000.

grounded_prompts.prompt: Which warehouse node caused a delay in CASE-10298 and how many days were added?
grounded_prompts.expected_fact: Warehouse node W-14 caused a delay of 4 days.

grounded_prompts.prompt: What is the amount and resource for the Purchase Order in CASE-10231?
grounded_prompts.expected_fact: Amount is $128,500.00, handled by Anita Rao in Procurement.
